name: Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep
tagline_zh: 睡前丢个想法，醒来收获实验报告。跨模型评审循环自动跑，连代码都帮你写好了，还附赠新点子。
tagline_en: Drop an idea before bed, wake up to a full experiment report. Cross-model review loops auto-run, code included.
desc_en: ARIS ⚔️ (Auto-Research-In-Sleep) — Lightweight Markdown-only skills for autonomous ML research: cross-model review loops, idea discovery, and experime
why_zh: 同类工具只会跑脚本，它用多模型互评循环自动迭代，连实验细节和下一步思路都替你补齐。
why_en: Unlike script runners, it uses cross-model review loops to iterate autonomously, filling in experiment details and next-step.
